name: pethost-sandboxes
description: Sandboxes for AI agents: Firecracker microVMs that run code, coding agents and a browser. A skill that says when and how, and the Pethost Agent Sandboxes MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Pethost Agent Sandboxes gives an agent Linux computers of its own: Firecracker microVMs, each with its own kernel, made from a template in about 0.15 s, with Python, Node.js, Docker, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and a desktop with Chrome. Run code and tests, give a coding agent its own computer, drive Chrome, save a sandbox as a template to start from. A sandbox pauses with its memory when idle and wakes at the next call. It signs in by OAuth: you approve the agent in your browser.
defaultPrompt: Run this script in a Pethost sandbox and show me what it prints
Open this page in Chrome in a sandbox and take a screenshot
Let Codex refactor this repository in a sandbox
